stat.arcanequest.agility.desc: +0.5% movement speed and +1% attack speed per point
stat.arcanequest.intelligence.desc: +5 max mana and +5% spell power per point
message.arcanequest.level_up: Level up! You are now level %s (+%s stat points, press K)
message.arcanequest.choose_class: You can choose your class! Press K, Skills tab.
class.arcanequest.mage.desc: Intelligence. +50% mana, +30% spell power, 10% magic critical hits (x1.5). Each kill gives back 3 mana.
class.arcanequest.mage.lore: Elemental artillery. Inspiration: Choi Jong-In, the "Ultimate Hunter", and his Flame Spear.
class.arcanequest.assassin.desc: Agility. Critical hits x2, +10% speed and attack speed. Hits in the back: +30% damage.
class.arcanequest.assassin.lore: Swift killer aiming at vital points. Inspiration: Sung Jinwoo before his Job Change (Mutilation, Dagger Rush, Stealth).
spell.arcanequest.fire_bolt.desc: Burning bolt that sets the target on fire.
spell.arcanequest.frost_bolt.desc: Icy bolt that slows the target.
spell.arcanequest.arcane_missile.desc: Fast, strong bolt that weakens the target.
spell.arcanequest.lightning.desc: Calls lightning where you aim (32 blocks).
spell.arcanequest.arcane_barrage.desc: Fires 5 arcane missiles in a fan.
tooltip.arcanequest.summon: Use on a block to summon: %s
weapon.arcanequest.dagger.desc: Very fast. x1.75 damage from behind.
weapon.arcanequest.katana.desc: Fast. Right click: slashing dash forward.
weapon.arcanequest.longsword.desc: Two-handed, slow. Every hit cleaves enemies in front of you.
weapon.arcanequest.scythe.desc: Reaps every enemy around you and heals you.
screen.arcanequest.crafting_hint: For 3×3 recipes, use a crafting table.
screen.arcanequest.class_spend_points: Spend your stat points: the 3 classes offered depend on your stats.
message.arcanequest.class_unlocked: Level 20: you can choose your class! (K, Skills tab)
class.arcanequest.berserker.desc: Strength. +15% melee, +10% attack speed, +30% damage below ½ health. Each kill: Strength and Speed for 3 s.
class.arcanequest.berserker.lore: Raging melee fighter. Inspiration: Sung Jinwoo's Bloodlust and the Fighter-type hunters.
class.arcanequest.paladin.desc: Strength + Vitality. +2 hearts, +2 armor, +10% melee, each hit heals ½ heart, +20% against undead.
class.arcanequest.paladin.lore: Holy warrior, between offense and support. Inspiration: the light of the Rulers, enemies of the Monarchs.
class.arcanequest.guardian.desc: Vitality. +4 hearts, +4 armor, +2 toughness, +30% knockback resistance. Tenacity: -20% damage taken below 30% health.
class.arcanequest.guardian.lore: Tank who takes the hits for the party. Inspiration: the Tank class of Solo Leveling: Arise and Sung Jinwoo's Tenacity.
class.arcanequest.duelist.desc: Strength + Agility. +10% melee, +15% attack speed, critical hits x1.75, 5% dodge.
class.arcanequest.duelist.lore: Nimble swordfighter with precise combos. Inspiration: Cha Hae-In and her Sword Dance.
class.arcanequest.ranger.desc: Agility + Vitality. +35% arrow damage, +10% speed, +1 heart. First strike: +20% against unharmed targets.
class.arcanequest.ranger.lore: Mobile archer and trapper. Inspiration: the Ranger class of Solo Leveling: Arise.
class.arcanequest.spellblade.desc: Strength + Intelligence. +10% melee, +15% spell power. Each melee hit gives 2 mana.
class.arcanequest.spellblade.lore: Blade imbued with magic. Inspiration: the Demon King Baran's daggers wielded by Sung Jinwoo.
class.arcanequest.cleric.desc: Vitality + Intelligence. +2 hearts, +10% spell power, heals x1.5, regenerates ½ heart / 4 s. Aura: heals nearby allies.
class.arcanequest.cleric.lore: Party healer. Inspiration: Lee Joohee, the healer of the Double Dungeon.
class.arcanequest.arcanist.desc: Agility + Intelligence. Spells 30% cheaper, +10% spell power, +10% speed, 8% magic critical hits.
class.arcanequest.arcanist.lore: Mobile mage who bends space. Inspiration: the space magic of S-rank mages.
message.arcanequest.awakening: Level 50: AWAKENING! Your class can evolve (K, Skills tab)
class.arcanequest.monk.desc: Strength + Agility + Vitality. +5 bare-handed damage, +10% attack speed, +5% speed. Combo: +6% per hit (5 max).
class.arcanequest.monk.lore: Bare-handed fighter chaining blows. Inspiration: the Fighter hunters who fight with their fists.
class.arcanequest.necromancer.desc: Intelligence + a bit of everything. 15% of killed monsters rise as shadows (3 max, 1 min). +10% spells, +3 mana per kill.
class.arcanequest.necromancer.lore: Summoner of the dead. Inspiration: the Necromancer, the class offered to Sung Jinwoo by his Job Change quest.
class.arcanequest.warlord.desc: Berserker awakening. +2 hearts, +25% melee, +15% attack speed, +50% below ½ health. 5 s frenzy per kill, 15% Tenacity.
class.arcanequest.warlord.lore: Tireless warlord. Inspiration: Go Gunhee, chairman of the Hunter Association, and his crushing fists.
class.arcanequest.executioner.desc: Berserker awakening. +20% melee, +10% attack speed, +60% against enemies below 30% health. Each kill heals 2 hearts.
class.arcanequest.executioner.lore: Finishes off whatever weakens. Inspiration: the brutality of Hwang Dongsoo, S-rank hunter.
class.arcanequest.fortress.desc: Guardian awakening. +6 hearts, +6 armor, +4 toughness, +50% knockback resistance, -15% damage taken, 30% Tenacity.
class.arcanequest.fortress.lore: Living wall. Inspiration: Thomas Andre, "the Goliath", national level hunter.
class.arcanequest.rune_guardian.desc: Guardian awakening. +5 hearts, +5 armor, +2 toughness, sends back 30% of melee damage, 20% Tenacity, +25% mana.
class.arcanequest.rune_guardian.lore: Tank with magic barriers that send the blows back. Inspiration: the mana barriers of S-rank tanks.
class.arcanequest.ninja.desc: Assassin awakening. 25% dodge, critical hits x2, +20% speed, +15% attack speed, +30% in the back.
class.arcanequest.ninja.lore: Elusive, striking from everywhere at once. Inspiration: the S-rank assassins and their dagger techniques.
class.arcanequest.shadow_assassin.desc: Assassin awakening. Critical hits x2.5, +60% in the back, invisible while sneaking. +15% attack speed, +10% speed.
class.arcanequest.shadow_assassin.lore: Invisible killer. Inspiration: Kang Taeshik, the stealthy assassin, and Sung Jinwoo's Stealth.
class.arcanequest.archmage.desc: Mage awakening. Mana and regeneration x2, +60% spell power, 20% magic critical hits, +6 mana per kill.
class.arcanequest.archmage.lore: Raw magic power. Inspiration: Choi Jong-In, master of flames.
class.arcanequest.elementalist.desc: Mage awakening. +50% mana, +40% spell power, 10% magic critical hits. Each hit burns (3 s) and slows.
class.arcanequest.elementalist.lore: Master of fire, ice and lightning. Inspiration: the Frost Monarch and Baran, Monarch of White Flames.
class.arcanequest.crusader.desc: Paladin awakening. +4 hearts, +4 armor, +15% melee, each hit heals 1 heart. Aura: heals nearby allies.
class.arcanequest.crusader.lore: Standard-bearer leading the charge. Inspiration: the Rulers and their armies of light.
class.arcanequest.holy_knight.desc: Paladin awakening. +3 hearts, +3 armor, +15% melee, heals ½ heart per hit, +60% against undead.
class.arcanequest.holy_knight.lore: Knight of light, bane of the dead. Inspiration: the Rulers, whose vessels are the national level hunters.
class.arcanequest.weapon_master.desc: Duelist awakening. +20% melee, +25% attack speed, critical hits x2, 5% dodge.
class.arcanequest.weapon_master.lore: Master of every blade. Inspiration: Liu Zhigang, China's national level swordsman.
class.arcanequest.windblade.desc: Duelist awakening. +20% speed and attack speed, +15% melee, critical hits x1.75, 12% dodge.
class.arcanequest.windblade.lore: Dancer of the wind. Inspiration: Cha Hae-In and her Sword Dance.
class.arcanequest.sniper.desc: Ranger awakening. +70% arrow damage, +10% speed, +1 heart. First strike: +50% against unharmed targets.
class.arcanequest.sniper.lore: Very long range marksman. Inspiration: the elite archers of the great guilds.
class.arcanequest.hunter.desc: Ranger awakening. +45% arrow damage, each hit slows, +15% speed, +2 hearts, +20% against unharmed targets.
class.arcanequest.hunter.lore: Hunter and his pack. Inspiration: Rakan, Monarch of Fangs and king of beasts.
class.arcanequest.rune_knight.desc: Spellblade awakening. +20% melee, +30% spell power, +2 armor. Each melee hit gives 4 mana.
class.arcanequest.rune_knight.lore: Knight of runic lightning. Inspiration: Baran, the Demon King, and his lightning daggers.
class.arcanequest.warlock.desc: Spellblade awakening. +35% spell power, +10% melee. Spells heal 25% of their damage. +4 mana per kill.
class.arcanequest.warlock.lore: Dark magic and demonic pacts. Inspiration: the demons of the Demon Castle.
class.arcanequest.saint.desc: Cleric awakening. +3 hearts, +20% spell power, heals x2.5, regenerates ½ heart / 2 s. Strong aura: heals allies every 3 s.
class.arcanequest.saint.lore: The best healer in the country. Inspiration: Min Byung-Gu, S-rank healer.
class.arcanequest.druid.desc: Cleric awakening. +4 hearts, +15% spell power, heals x1.75, regeneration. Each hit poisons.
class.arcanequest.druid.lore: Shaman of nature and beasts. Inspiration: Tusk, Sung Jinwoo's orc shaman shadow.
class.arcanequest.chronomancer.desc: Arcanist awakening. Spells 50% cheaper, +20% spell power, +15% speed, 10% magic critical hits.
class.arcanequest.chronomancer.lore: Master of time. Inspiration: the Architect, creator of the System.
class.arcanequest.battlemage.desc: Arcanist awakening. +30% spell power, spells 25% cheaper, +10% melee and attack speed, +15% speed, 2 mana per hit.
class.arcanequest.battlemage.lore: Warrior mage. Inspiration: Esil Radiru, the demon noble who fights with spear and magic.
class.arcanequest.grandmaster.desc: Monk awakening. +10 bare-handed damage, +20% attack speed, +10% speed. Combo: +10% per hit (5 max).
class.arcanequest.grandmaster.lore: Master of martial arts. Inspiration: Baek Yoonho and his beast form (white tiger).
class.arcanequest.iron_monk.desc: Monk awakening. +7 bare-handed damage, +3 hearts, +6 armor, +30% knockback resistance, 20% Tenacity, +5% combo.
class.arcanequest.iron_monk.lore: Body of steel. Inspiration: Iron, Sung Jinwoo's shield-bearing shadow.
class.arcanequest.lich_lord.desc: Necromancer awakening. 30% of killed monsters become shadows (5 max, 2 min). +50% mana, +25% spells, +5 mana per kill.
class.arcanequest.lich_lord.lore: Lord of the dead. Inspiration: Yogumunt, Monarch of Transfiguration.
class.arcanequest.shadow_monarch.desc: Hidden class (Skeleton King defeated). 50% of killed monsters join your army for good (8 max). +3 hearts, +15% melee, +20% spells, 30% Tenacity, regeneration.
class.arcanequest.shadow_monarch.lore: King of shadows. Inspiration: Sung Jinwoo, the Shadow Monarch: Shadow Extraction, Shadow Exchange, Ruler's Authority, Dragon's Fear.
screen.arcanequest.hidden_class: Hidden class: a secret condition must be met...
skill.arcanequest.charge.desc: Dash forward, knocking down every enemy in the way.
skill.arcanequest.whirlwind.desc: Spin three times, hitting everything around you (4 blocks).
skill.arcanequest.ground_slam.desc: Smash the ground: damage around you, enemies thrown up.
skill.arcanequest.earthquake.desc: Three ever wider shockwaves that hurt and slow.
skill.arcanequest.war_cry.desc: Strength II and speed for you, weakness for enemies within 10 blocks.
skill.arcanequest.bloodlust.desc: Your killing intent terrifies enemies (10 blocks): they flee, weakened and slowed. Strength I for you.
skill.arcanequest.blood_frenzy.desc: For 10 s, your melee hits heal you for 30% of the damage.
skill.arcanequest.berserk.desc: Strength III, speed and haste for 10 s, but you take 30% more damage.
skill.arcanequest.execute.desc: A mighty blow on the target; x3 if it is below 30% health.
skill.arcanequest.reaping_cleave.desc: Wide sweep in front of you; x2 on weakened enemies, each kill heals you 2 hearts.
skill.arcanequest.blade_dance.desc: Appear behind up to 5 nearby enemies and strike them one by one.
skill.arcanequest.taunt.desc: Every nearby monster attacks you; you gain Resistance II.
skill.arcanequest.shield_bash.desc: Stun the target, push it back and force it to attack you.
skill.arcanequest.shield_wall.desc: Resistance III for 5 s, but you are slowed.
skill.arcanequest.iron_skin.desc: Absorb 8 hearts of damage and gain Resistance for 15 s.
skill.arcanequest.bulwark.desc: Taunt monsters (12 blocks); Resistance II and absorption for you and nearby players.
skill.arcanequest.parry.desc: For 3 s, block the next attack and strike back.
skill.arcanequest.flurry.desc: Six lightning-fast blows on the target.
skill.arcanequest.tornado.desc: A tornado throws nearby enemies into the air.
skill.arcanequest.sword_dance.desc: Five flowing slashes while gliding forward, like Cha Hae-In; Resistance II while dancing.
skill.arcanequest.sword_wave.desc: A wave of sword energy cuts every enemy in line (12 blocks).
skill.arcanequest.palm_strike.desc: Shockwave throwing the enemies in front far away; much stronger bare-handed.
skill.arcanequest.holy_banner.desc: Plant a banner for 10 s: allies get Strength and Regeneration, enemies burn in the light.
skill.arcanequest.mutilation.desc: Three critical strikes at the vital points, then the target bleeds for 4 s.
skill.arcanequest.shadow_step.desc: Teleport behind the target (16 blocks), strike and blind it.
skill.arcanequest.stealth.desc: Invisible and forgotten by monsters for 8 s; your first hit deals double damage.
skill.arcanequest.dagger_rush.desc: Eight daggers strike the target from every direction (14 blocks).
skill.arcanequest.smoke_bomb.desc: Invisible and fast for 6 s; nearby enemies are blinded and lose you.
skill.arcanequest.poison_blade.desc: For 12 s, your hits poison (Poison II), like Kasaka's venom fang.
skill.arcanequest.arrow_rain.desc: Arrows rain down where you aim.
skill.arcanequest.piercing_shot.desc: A shot that goes through every enemy in line (40 blocks).
skill.arcanequest.evasive_shot.desc: Leap back while shooting 3 arrows; enemies too close are slowed.
skill.arcanequest.explosive_arrow.desc: An arrow that explodes on the aimed target (3 blocks) and knocks back.
skill.arcanequest.trap.desc: Brambles root and hurt the enemies around (6 blocks).
skill.arcanequest.deadeye.desc: Your arrows deal double damage for 10 s; night vision.
skill.arcanequest.hunters_mark.desc: Mark the prey (30 blocks): it glows and takes +30% damage from you and your wolves.
skill.arcanequest.summon_wolves.desc: Summon 2 spirit wolves that fight for you for 1 min.
skill.arcanequest.fireball.desc: Throw a fireball that sets on fire.
skill.arcanequest.flame_spear.desc: A spear of fire pierces everything over 30 blocks and burns, like Choi Jong-In.
skill.arcanequest.frost_nova.desc: Freeze and heavily slow everything around you (6 blocks).
skill.arcanequest.glacial_spikes.desc: Ice spikes burst out in a line (14 blocks) and freeze what they pierce.
skill.arcanequest.chain_lightning.desc: Lightning strikes the target, then jumps to 4 other enemies.
skill.arcanequest.meteor_strike.desc: A meteor crashes where you aim after 1.5 s (heavy area damage).
skill.arcanequest.arcane_barrage.desc: Five arcane missiles in a fan.
skill.arcanequest.arcane_slash.desc: A crescent of magic mows down the enemies in front of you and slows them.
skill.arcanequest.gravity_well.desc: Space folds where you aim: enemies are pulled in for 3 s, then crushed.
skill.arcanequest.time_stop.desc: Nearby enemies (12 blocks) are frozen for 4 s.
skill.arcanequest.rewind.desc: Reset all your other skills and heal 25% of your health.
skill.arcanequest.mana_shield.desc: A shield that absorbs damage, stronger with more mana.
skill.arcanequest.runic_ward.desc: An 8 s glyph: allies inside resist, enemies are slowed and burnt.
skill.arcanequest.life_drain.desc: Steal the target's life and heal yourself as much.
skill.arcanequest.curse.desc: Nearby enemies wither and are weakened.
skill.arcanequest.soul_harvest.desc: Tear the souls of nearby enemies: damage, plus health and mana for each.
skill.arcanequest.rune_blade.desc: For 12 s, your hits deal extra magic damage and give mana.
skill.arcanequest.heal_aura.desc: Heal yourself and nearby players, with regeneration.
skill.arcanequest.purify.desc: Remove harmful effects from allies (10 blocks), heal and protect them; burns undead.
skill.arcanequest.smite.desc: A column of light strikes the target (double against undead).
skill.arcanequest.judgment.desc: Light strikes every enemy within 10 blocks (double against undead).
skill.arcanequest.sanctuary.desc: A 10 s holy zone heals players and burns enemies.
skill.arcanequest.corpse_explosion.desc: Your shadow closest to the crosshair explodes: the tougher it is, the more it hurts.
skill.arcanequest.arise.desc: Shadow Extraction: monsters you killed here (12 blocks, 1 min) rise, ranked by strength. 3 tries per corpse.
skill.arcanequest.shadow_exchange.desc: Appear where the shadow you aim at stands (or the farthest one).
skill.arcanequest.rulers_authority.desc: Telekinesis: lift the enemies in front and slam them down. Sneaking: push everything away.
skill.arcanequest.dragons_fear.desc: A dragon's roar: terror over 16 blocks, enemies flee, slowed and weakened.
skill.arcanequest.cataclysm.desc: Leap to the aimed point and crash down in three shockwaves that terrify the survivors.
skill.arcanequest.death_sentence.desc: Mark every enemy within 12 blocks; 3 s later, a heavy blow + 40% of their missing health.
skill.arcanequest.goliath.desc: Become a giant for 15 s: size x1.6, +10 hearts, +8 armor, +30% damage, unshakable.
skill.arcanequest.aegis.desc: 8 s: Resistance II and all damage taken is sent back to the attacker.
skill.arcanequest.thousand_cuts.desc: Untouchable, strike 12 times between nearby enemies, then come back.
skill.arcanequest.assassination.desc: Killing blow in the back (24 blocks), x2 while invisible; a kill makes you invisible.
skill.arcanequest.inferno.desc: For 3 s, twelve fire blasts ravage the aimed area.
skill.arcanequest.white_flames.desc: Baran's lightning strikes 5 times up to 6 nearby enemies (16 blocks).
skill.arcanequest.crusade.desc: 15 s: Strength II, Resistance and speed for you and your allies; your hits strike with light.
skill.arcanequest.rulers_light.desc: Light strikes and blinds every enemy within 12 blocks; allies are healed and shielded.
skill.arcanequest.heaven_splitter.desc: 1 s to focus, then a giant cut splits everything over 24 blocks.
skill.arcanequest.tempest_dance.desc: 5 s: become a storm cutting and pulling enemies in; half of the attacks miss you.
skill.arcanequest.heavens_arrow.desc: 1 s to aim, then an arrow of light pierces everything over 64 blocks.
skill.arcanequest.rakans_howl.desc: Four great wolves answer your howl (30 s); you grow stronger, enemies tremble.
skill.arcanequest.thunder_blade.desc: Three lightning bolts fall in front of you, then your blade is charged with runes.
skill.arcanequest.demonic_pact.desc: Sacrifice 25% of your health: 15 s of +50% spells that heal you.
skill.arcanequest.saving_grace.desc: Heal allies (16 blocks); for 20 s, they survive one deadly blow.
skill.arcanequest.verdant_grove.desc: 10 s: nature heals allies and chokes enemies (poison, slowness).
skill.arcanequest.temporal_collapse.desc: Freeze enemies within 16 blocks for 5 s; when time resumes, they take it all at once.
skill.arcanequest.arcane_avatar.desc: 15 s: speed, strength, resistance; each of your hits bursts with magic around the target.
skill.arcanequest.beast_form.desc: 20 s: become a beast, bigger, faster, stronger, jumping higher and regenerating.
skill.arcanequest.adamantine_body.desc: 8 s: Resistance III, unshakable, sends half the blows back; then a shockwave.
skill.arcanequest.death_plague.desc: A deadly 10 s cloud where you aim; every monster killed meanwhile becomes a shadow.
skill.arcanequest.monarch_domain.desc: 15 s: your shadows, healed, deal +50% damage; you grow stronger, enemies sink into darkness.
screen.arcanequest.abilities_no_class: Choose a class (level %s) to unlock its abilities.
screen.arcanequest.ability_ultimate.desc: Ultimate skill of your awakened class (level 100).
message.arcanequest.gate_opened: A %s Gate opened %s blocks away (%s)! Recommended level: %s
message.arcanequest.gate_entered: Monster level: ~%s. Defeat the gate master to clear it. The exit is behind you.
message.arcanequest.gate_clear: %s Gate cleared! +%s XP. The dungeon's treasure appeared.
message.arcanequest.gate_cleared: This gate has already been cleared.
message.arcanequest.petrified: The basilisk's gaze petrifies you! Look away...
message.arcanequest.charmed: The succubus charms you and draws you to her...
